producer_report.summary: Root cause: the reader brief's 'Prompt token headroom' section listed sets by component id, so a reading had to work out which sets compose a prompt file and take the smallest room itself. I added `prompt_file_path` and `file_headroom` to athena-context. They derive each file's path, composing sets and tightest room from the same HeadroomRow list the budgets test checks. `headroom_section` now prints one line per file after the unchanged per-set rows. No refusal rule is added. I added tests in athena-context and athena-core, a CHANGELOG entry and decision D185.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs has a function that maps each prompt component (contract, frame.*, capability.<id>.producer/verifier) to its repository path (e.g. crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md, crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md) and, from the HeadroomRow list, returns for each file the sets that compose it and the smallest tokens-left among them.
criteria_check.evidence: prompt_file_path and file_headroom added in lib.rs; cargo test -p athena-context headroom passes, including a disk test that each mapped path equals the compiled-in text.

criteria_check.criterion: headroom_section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs renders that per-file table under '# Prompt token headroom', as lines naming the file path, its sets and the tightest room, in addition to the existing per-set rows.
criteria_check.evidence: headroom_section prints a lead line and '- path: composed by sets; tightest room N tokens left' after the unchanged per-set loop; cargo test -p athena-context reader_brief passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test in crates/athena-context builds rows where shared frame.verifier is composed by verifier (change) with 59 left and verifier (study) with 36 left, and asserts the per-file entry for crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md lists both sets and says 36 left; it fails without the change. Run: cargo test -p athena-context headroom.
criteria_check.evidence: headroom_per_file_takes_the_tightest_of_the_sets_that_compose_it passes; file_headroom does not exist without the change so it would not compile.

criteria_check.criterion: A reader-brief test asserts the rendered brief contains the line for crates/athena-context/prompts/contract.md with every set composing it and the minimum room, and that no per-file section appears when headroom is empty. Run: cargo test -p athena-context reader_brief.

A test in athena-core (reading brief path, next to the_reading_brief_carries_the_token_headroom_of_the_reader_and_verifier_sets in run_pin_tests.rs) asserts the real reading brief includes a per-file line for crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md. Run: cargo test -p athena-core token_headroom.
criteria_check.evidence: the_reading_brief_names_the_token_headroom_per_prompt_file passes alongside the existing test (2 passed).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an [Unreleased] entry naming the root cause (the brief gave per-set rows by component id, not per-file room); a new appended docs/decisions.md decision with a Provenance bullet may record it. Existing entries are not edited.
criteria_check.evidence: One bullet added under [Unreleased] / Changed; D185 appended after D184 with Provenance; no existing text edited; mirrors test passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The recorded fmt, clippy and test checks pass on the final tree (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy, cargo test).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; I ran fmt --check and clippy (pass) and the targeted tests, budgets, mirrors and policy tests, not the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: No refusal rule is added; expected 0% of newly refused readings.
criteria_check.evidence: The diff adds only two pure functions, brief text lines and tests; reading.rs and refusal code are untouched.

open_issues: The full cargo test --locked suite was not run by me; it is left to Athena's checks.
learnings: The Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm, so output cannot be piped to tail, grep or wc.
The core test filter token_headroom matches any test with that substring in its name.
